Amardeep is elated after Biji requests Ilahi to showcase her singing talents. Meanwhile, Jahaan confides in Dolly about her feelings for Ilahi.
The contestants are surprised when they are tasked with baking a cake. With a set of imposing guidelines, the chefs go to extreme lengths to impress the judges.

Summer und Morty können sich absolut gar nicht von ihrer neuen ultrarealistischen Videospielkonsole trennen und sitzen voller Spannung davor. Darüber hinaus steht eines der Lieblingsfeiertage der ganzen Familie Smith an.

Der Schulkrankenschwester wächst ein toter Fötus am Kopf und die Erwachsenen zeigen sich betroffen. Unterdessen haben die Kinder die Möglichkeit Weltmeister im Völkerball zu werden und müssen sich im Finale mit China messen.

Die Kinder wollen sich an Stans Onkel Jimbo und an Ned rächen, weil diese gelogen haben. Es entspinnt sich ein Kleinkrieg, der bis in die Fernsehlandschaft reicht und auch Jesus und seinen Kumpels Quoten kostet.

Die Busfahrerin Mrs. Crabtree verursacht einen Verkehrsunfall mit dem Schulbus und muss Hilfe holen. Sie wird aber abgelenkt und in der Zwischenzeit erinnern sich die Jungs an ihr bisheriges Leben und was ihnen alles zugestoßen ist.

Wegen eines missglückten Feuerwerks werden für den 4. Juli alle Feuerwerke verboten. Jimbo und Ned flüchten deshalb nach Mexiko, um dort ihrer Leidenschaft nachgehen zu können. Unterdessen wird in South Park versucht die Feier zu retten.

Das Sundance Filmfestival zieht nach South Park und es kommt zum Konflikt mit den Filmleuten. Ihre Ernährung belastet das Kanalsystem und droht Mr. Hankey zu töten. Nur Chefkoch kann ihn noch retten, damit dieser dem Festival ein Ende bereitet.

In dieser Folge sorgt Dick Genie dafür, dass Billy endlich seine Unschuld verliert. Ein Chinese möchte sich eine amerikanische Frau aus einem Katalog bestellen. Abschließend wird gezeigt, wie Bethiffer ihren Schwarm beglücken will.
Larry David isst mit Larry Flynt zu Mittag. Ein Killer macht Jagd auf Haustiere. Gary spielt an seinem freien Tag mit seinem Sohn Minigolf. Allerdings wird die Familien-Idylle von Streichen gestört.

Jeff muss heute einen Sexpartner finden, um die Zerstörung der Erde durch Aliens zu verhindern. Ein Arzt macht zudem Zaubertricks, während er Geburtshilfe leistet. Bethiffer ist mit einem Virtual-Reality-Spiel beschäftigt.

Toot ist nach der Arbeit erschöpft und kommt ins Drawn Together-Haus, um sich etwas auszuruhen. Als sie jedoch in ihr Zimmer geht, sieht sie, dass Foxxy mit Scooby-Doo Geschlechtsverkehr hat. Sie verwechselt den Vierbeiner leider mit Astro.

Randy Marsh ist unter seinen Kumpels neuerdings der Größte: Er hat den fettesten Haufen produziert, den man sich vorstellen kann. Diesen Ruhm will Randy zum großen Frust seiner Frau in alle Welt tragen und bewirbt sich mit dem riesigen Kotstück für den Weltrekord. Fragt sich nur, wie der aktuelle Rekordhalter Bono darauf reagieren wird.

Um all dem Medienrummel zu entkommen, fährt Popstar Britney Spears in die Berge von South Park. Doch wird sie dort schnell entdeckt und auch die Jungs wollen ein Foto von ihr machen, um es teuer zu verkaufen. Nachdem dabei etwas Schreckliches passiert, lassen die Medien trotzdem nicht locker und verfolgen Britney weiter überall hin.

Katzen sind in South Park ab sofort illegal, nachdem ihr Urin für Drogen verwendet wird. Kenny ist abhängig und verfällt unter ihrem Rausch in Halluzinationen wie im Film "Heavy Metal" von 1981. Cartman versucht, die Nachbarkatzen zu verstecken.

Da Kanada zu wenig Aufmerksamkeit bekommt, führt der Leiter des "Welt Kanada Büros" das ganze Land in einen schmerzhaften, langen Streik. Die Forderung: Kanada will etwas von dem Internetgeld. Kyle, Stan und Cartman versuchen, das Geld zu besorgen. Denn sie wollen wieder ihre Lieblingssendung "Terrance & Philip" sehen, die eben aus Kanada kommt. Bei der Suche nach dem Internetgeld treffen die Jungs dabei auf einige Stars des World Wide Webs.

Ms. Garrison möchte doch wieder ein Mann sein und lässt sich im Genlabor einen Penis züchten. Dieser wächst auf einer Maus, die aber aus dem Labor entwischt. Währenddessen übernimmt Cartman den Job als Lehrer in der Schule und hat vollen Erfolg.

Cartman verspottet Wendy für ihr Schulreferat zum Thema Brustkrebs. Dafür fordert sie ihn zu einem Kampf heraus. Als Cartman merkt, wie böse Wendy wirklich ist, will er unter allen Umständen den Kampf vermeiden, um sich nicht vor allen zu blamieren.

Nachdem Louises Kartensammlung beschlagnahmt wurde, schmiedet er einen Plan, um sie zurückzuholen. Aufgrund eines unerwünschten Vorfalls bekommt Bob außerdem die Aufgabe, eine Lobesrede auf einen alten Bekannten zu halten.

In der Straße der Belchers eröffnet ein fieser Konkurrent einen Saft-Imbiss. Louise ist fest entschlossen, das Territorium ihrer Familie zurückzuerobern. Linda muss feststellen, dass ihre Schwester auch ohne ihre Hilfe zurechtkommen muss.

Die Belchers haben beschlossen, einen Tag der offenen Tür zu veranstalten. An diesem wollen sie Kostproben verteilen und somit neue Kunden anziehen. Linda trifft auf einen charmanten Makler, der sie um eine Privatführung bittet.

Tina hat sich dazu entschlossen, den Junior-Lebensrettern beizutreten. Doch das Training ist schwieriger als gedacht. Jetzt muss sie eine Entscheidung treffen. Währenddessen floriert das Geschäft, weil Bob und Linda im Laden nun auch W-LAN anbieten.

Als Bob sich gerade über den Wert der Arbeit im Restaurantbetrieb wundert, bittet ein Paar, das sich im Restaurant verliebt hat, die Belchers, ihre Hochzeit zu organisieren. Als die Dinge nicht wie geplant laufen, versucht Linda, den Tag zu retten.

Roger beschließt, Fotos von sich zu veröffentlichen. Daraufhin gerät die CIA in Panik und initiiert eine Alien-Taskforce. Zufällig arbeitet Roger bei dieser mit. Stan bekommt dadurch familiäre Probleme und einen neuen Vorgesetzten - nämlich Roger.

Francine besucht ihre Eltern, obwohl Stan dagegen ist. Roger plant in der Zwischenzeit, der "King of Spring Break" zu werden. Während Steve versucht, seine Jungfräulichkeit an Carmen Electra zu verlieren, findet Stan Geschmack an Jessica.

Steve hält die Familie in Atem, als er bekannt gibt, dass er in der Pubertät ist. Francine will das verhindern und flößt ihm ein geheimes Mittel mit fatalen Folgen ein. Aufgrund der großen Aufregung findet Rogers 1600. Geburtstag wenig Beachtung.

Roger entdeckt, dass jemand mit einer Partnerkarte seine Kreditkarte ausgereizt hat und beschließt, den Gauner zu finden. Als er diesen tatsächlich findet, macht er ihm das Leben schwer und Familie Smith gerät in ein kompliziertes Verwirrspiel.

Hals droht seinen Job zu verlieren, nachdem er ein Motivationsseminar belegt hat. Seine Mitarbeiter sind nun so eifrig, dass sie ihren Job besser machen als Hal. Reese wird Anführer eines Hunderudels.
Malcolm hilft einem arbeitslosen Stelzenläufer wieder Arbeit zu finden. Hal vertelefoniert 800 Dollar bei einer Sex-Hotline und Lois ist dementsprechend schlecht gelaunt.
Hal wird zum Präsidenten des Nachbarschaftsvereins gewählt. Malcolm verspricht sich davon so einige Vorteile, doch schon nach kurzer Zeit hat Hal alle Nachbarn gegen sich aufgehetzt.

Malcolm, Reese und Dewey melden ihre Mutter bei einem Schönheitswettbewerb an. Auch Hal unterstützt die Idee und stellt fortan alles vor Lois' Erfolg. Reese findet unterdessen heraus, dass er dem absoluten Schönheitsideal entspricht.
Malcolm und Reese fahren gemeinsam zum berühmten Burning-Man-Festival. Reese verliebt sich Hals über Kopf und will gar nicht mehr, dass das Festival jemals wieder endet.

Als Sam und Jay die Geister dazu bringen, zusammenzuziehen, damit ihre Zimmer für Gäste im B&B frei werden, erfahren sie, dass Thorfinn unter Nachtschrecken leidet. Deshalb hat Sam die Idee, einen Therapeuten zu beauftragen.

Das Geheimnis um Trevors fehlende Hose wird gelüftet, als einer seiner ehemaligen, wohlhabenden Freunde auftaucht, um eine Uhr zu kaufen, die Sam und Jay bei Elias Leiche gefunden haben. Thor beschließt, Flower seine Gefühle für sie zu beichten.
Jay und Manny sind gegen Glorias Entschluss, einen männlichen Babysitter einzustellen. Phil und Jay versuchen, Frank aufzumuntern.
Phil und Claire bereiten sich gegenseitig eine Überraschung zum 20. Hochzeitstag. Die Familie besucht das jährliche Schulfest. Haley hat eine seltsame Begegnung.
Claire unterstützt Jays Entscheidung, auf die ClosetCon zu gehen. Dort trifft Jay alte Freunde wieder. Cam nimmt Lily und Mitch mit auf die Tucker-Farm.
Cam ist sehr konzentriert - und rabiat - als ein großes Football-Spiel ansteht. Claire will sich mit ihrer Arbeit beweisen. Phil versucht, seinen Kindern Optimismus beizubringen.

Ethan, ein jüdischer Studienfreund von Snot, lädt Debbie, Steves Freundin, zu seiner Bar-Mizwa-Party ein. Da Debbie Ethan - im Gegensatz zu Steve - für einen echten Mann hält, lässt sie Steve sitzen, woraufhin dieser einen Racheplan schmiedet.

Nachdem Stan in Kolumbien entführt wird, krempelt Francine den Haushalt um, da sie ihn zurückerwartet. Doch Stan kommt unverletzt wieder und verkündet, dass er eine Ersatzfrau für den Fall von Francines Tod hat. Steve und Roger spielen Detektive.

Steve versucht krampfhaft, die Aufmerksamkeit seines Vaters zu erhaschen. Dabei entdeckt er, dass Stan seit Jahren heimlich an einem ganz speziellen Automobil bastelt: einem DeLorean DMC-12. Das Projekt ist fast vollendet, es fehlt nur noch eine sehr rare Beifahrertür. Um seinem Dad zu gefallen, setzt Steve alles daran, einen Besitzer einer solchen Tür zu lokalisieren. Als ihm dies gelingt, beginnt für Vater und Sohn eine interessante Reise.

Als Steve bei einer Chemieolympiade auf dem letzten Platz landet, bekommt er die Enttäuschung seines Vaters deutlich zu spüren. Er ist daraufhin todtraurig und würde alles dafür tun, um die Aufmerksamkeit seines Vaters zu bekommen.

Stan ist von Roger genervt, der sich immer noch für die wichtigste Person der Welt hält. Roger zeigt sich allerdings wenig beeindruckt, als Stan ihm seine Meinung sagt, und er will sich nun an ihm rächen. Mit einem Raumschiff will er das Haus der Stans in die Luft sprengen.

Tina will an der Rettungsschwimmerausbildung teilnehmen, als sie sich in einen der Jungen verliebt. Doch lernt sie bei ihrer Ausbildung weniger über die Rettung von Strandgästen, als dass sie ihre Augen nur auf den leicht bekleideten Teenager hat.

Parade-Teenager Vicky Pollard versucht, sich in den Backstagebereich eines Konzerts zu schmuggeln. Daffyd ist total angewidert, als die Barfrau Myfanwy ihre Freundin Rhiannon heiratet. Emily und Florence machen derweil auch auf dem Tennisplatz eine ausgezeichnete Figur. Für den Premierminister steht indes ein Fernsehauftritt auf dem Programm.

Lou hat für Andy ein Blinddate arrangiert, doch Andy ist von der Frau ganz und gar nicht begeistert. Vicky Pollard hat einen neuen Freund und der ist schwarz. Deswegen redet sie nun nur noch in einer Art Ghettoslang. Um sich zu erholen, begeben sich Andy und Lou zum Strand, während Andy Eis holt, geht Lou eine Runde schwimmen. Beim Premierminister läuft alles bestens.
Die Holzpromenade von Langley Falls wird wiedereröffnet, und niemand freut sich mehr als die Smiths.

Es treibt Steve in den Wahnsinn, dass er der Einzige in seinem Freundeskreis ist, der das neue Fast-Food-Restaurant nicht mag. Stan und Francine machen sich auf, um falsch zugestellte Post zurückzugeben.
Butters' Racheplan geht nach hinten los und löst eine Flut gefälschter Videos in der Schule aus.
Kyle hilft seinem kleinen Bruder Ike, sich bei Aura Battles nicht peinlich zu verhalten.

Im Mittelpunkt der animierten Komödie steht eine unvollkommene Familie von Menschen, Göttern und Monstern im mythischen antiken Griechenland, die versucht, eine der ersten Städte der Welt zu regieren, ohne sich gegenseitig umzubringen.

Im Mittelpunkt der animierten Komödie steht eine unvollkommene Familie von Menschen, Göttern und Monstern im mythischen antiken Griechenland, die versucht, eine der ersten Städte der Welt zu regieren, ohne sich gegenseitig umzubringen.
Butt-Head führt Beavis durch eine Abkürzung, als sie den Bus verpassen und ruiniert damit den Abend.

Beavis und Butt-Head fallen in einen Abwasserkanal und glauben, sie seien gestorben und in die Hölle gekommen, Butt-Head bringt Beavis ein neues Spiel bei und Beavis landet im Krankenhaus. Ein weiteres Abenteuer der beiden chaotischen Freunde.
Die alten Erdenherrscher wollen die Geschäftspraktiken ändern, was Rick so rein gar nicht gefällt.
Rick nutzt eine neuartige Technologie und der Rest der Familie will sie natürlich auch sofort ausprobieren. Rick gibt nach und es folgt: klassisches Rick-und-Morty-Chaos.

Die einfachen Besatzungsmitglieder der USS Cerritos erhalten die Aufgabe, die kürzlich renovierte USS Voyager zu ihrem neuen Ziel auf der Erde zu begleiten, wo sie als Museum dienen wird. Die Herausforderung beweist sich als äußerst schwierig.

Während eine rätselhafte Macht Raumschiffe stört und den Frieden gefährdet, bleibt die Cerritos-Crew unbehelligt und konzentriert sich auf alltägliche Aufgaben wie das Ausweichen vor bösen Computern und das Feststecken in Höhlen.

Monica regrets telling a fellow bride-to-be about a cheaper bridal shop, and later she has to fight the woman tooth and nail for a unique wedding dress before competing with her to hire Chandler's favourite band for the night. Meanwhile, Joey and Ross discover that they're dating the same girl.

Joey is overjoyed to be nominated for a 'Soapie', the third most prestigious award in daytime dramas. Meanwhile, engaged Monica frets when she realises she will never experience the thrill of a new relationship again, Ross spots Chandler sneaking out of a male strip club, and Phoebe meets a cute guy.
A special relationship develops between Butters and the Parish Priest. So when the town finds the church doors locked and no sign of the pair, they call in the Church.
Mr Hankey creates a poop storm on Twitter. His behaviour puts him in jeopardy of being fired as the Director of the Annual Christmas Pageant, so Kyle comes to the rescue.
Kyle is shocked to discover Butters is selling all kinds of fruity-flavoured vapes to the kindergarten kids. Randy is sick of city life and only hemp farming can cure this.
This year, a revolution in mobility is changing Halloween for everyone. Chaos erupts, as every kid is out on a candy harvesting rampage. Mackey and Kenny try to save the day.
When an animal rampage leads to dead children in town, the boys realise they need Al Gore's help. However, his solution might be going too far.
The boys break out of jail and try to work out who made the deal with ManBearPig. Then Satan steps up to help the boys.
Iain is joined by Guz Khan, Laura Smyth, Chloe Burrows and Hugh Davies to take down the internet's most ridiculous moments with sharp wit and savage humour.
Ray hopes the family-themed eulogy he gives for his Uncle Gus will extinguish the sparks of a festering family feud.
Robert asks Ray and Debra to complete IQ tests as part of his criminal psychology class. He tells them both that they scored higher than the other as part of an experiment.
When Ray's parents fall out, his mum moves in with him and Debra. Debra isn't happy, and tries to convince Ray's dad to apologise, but he's enjoying the single life too much.
Debra's well-to-do parents come to visit. Ray begs his parents to be nice to them, but when they all go out for a meal, it proves to be a tall order.
Caroline is impressed with Charlie's work around the house, but he finds more than he bargained for in her bathroom.
Charlie is expecting someone for dinner - but so is Caroline.
Caroline's university reunion brings a visit from her old rival - who helps herself to whatever she fancies.
Caroline disapproves of Charlie's attitude towards the children's fighting, but a traumatic day forces her to eat her words.
Caroline and Charlie lie to new acquaintances.
Joanna needs a bra, Charlie buys her a skateboard.

Featuring crime in shops, crime on the commute, and crime committed by pensioners!
Featuring stolen door mats, people falling from the sky, and stolen items inside someone's clothes!

The show that lifts the lid on the funnier side of crime. Including mayhem in a fireworks shop, traffic cone theft, and a digger driver's revenge.
We have bad delivery drivers, sleepy security guards, and Santa puts himself on the naughty list.
Features crimes against fashion, crimes against florists, and crimes committed by canines!
Lawless laughs featuring neighbourly disputes, car crime, and OAP outlaws.

Monica is so perturbed by Chandler's instant attraction to her gorgeous visiting cousin that she persuades Ross to let her stay at his flat. Despite being her blood relative, Ross cannot restrain himself from attempting to kiss her. She escapes to Phoebe's flat, but her beauty flabbergasts even Phoebe.

Rachel bumps into a girl she knew in college, and Monica tells everyone they made out once when they were drunk. While making their seating plans for the wedding, Chandler is sad that only 10 percent of the guests are his.
With only four weeks until their wedding, Monica and Chandler try to write their vows. Chandler enlists the boys' help, while Monica does the same with the girls.

Monica convinces a reluctant Chandler to travel to Las Vegas to invite his estranged cross-dressing father to their wedding. Meanwhile, Rachel is furious that she is the only friend who Monica has not allowed to drive the Porsche that her father gave her.
Monica and Chandler prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, Joey is starring in a movie with a prestigious actor with a spitting problem.
Joey encounters problems trying to get off the movie set to officiate the wedding when the star turns up drunk.

Monica and Chandler's wedding reception is almost upstaged by the news that someone might be pregnant. Meanwhile, Ross tries to impress a pretty single woman, Chandler has troubles on the dance floor, and Joey hopes to impress Chandler's mum's date, an important Broadway producer, with his acting ability.
The girls speculate as to who's the father of Rachel's baby, the guys scramble after Chandler loses the film from his wedding, and Monica wants to open the wedding gifts.
A topical panel show based on a huge series of opinion polls carried out around Britain. With guests Micky Flanagan, Stephen Mangan, Natalie Cassidy and Humphrey Ker.
A topical panel show based on a huge series of opinion polls carried out around Britain. With guests Louie Spence, Rachel Riley, David O'Doherty and Joe Lycett.
When aura battles take over South America, Kyle tries to help his little brother not be cringe.
Aisha Tyler hosts another episode of the improv show with Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with Greg Proops and star guest Lance Bass from legendary boy band *NSYNC. (S5, E07)
Following his two record-breaking DVDs 'Live and Laughing' and 'Hello Wembley', Michael returns with another show full of his observations.
Russell entertains with his trademark mix of eloquent gags and deft storytelling. Recorded at The Hammersmith Apollo.
Baba takes on his greatest challenge yet: a Don't Make Me Laugh farts special! (S2, E20)
Comedian Babatunde Aléshé presents funny clips of dating disasters, trick shot mishaps, and some of the clumsiest cats ever!

Murr, Sal, and Q learn a hard lesson about being kind to food service professionals, before heading off to give rock solid relationship advice; the losing joker is in for a shock, as his punishment is led by Colin Jost.
Murr, Sal, and Q perform a questionable taste test; the guys work off some of those calories with some CrossFit; Rob Riggle lets the losing joker show off that new swole gym body.

Phoebe's new job as a telemarketer gets off to a tricky start when the first person she calls, an office worker called Earl, tells her he feels unappreciated and wants to kill himself. Phoebe keeps him on the telephone, trying to persuade him otherwise and finally takes the desperate measure of going to his office to convince him to stay alive.

Celebrating Rachel's 30th birthday inspires the friends to reminisce about their own 30th birthdays. Joey got angry with God for breaking their deal, Ross bought himself a sports car in an attempt to recapture his youth, and Monica got blind drunk and embarrassed herself at her surprise party.

Joey accidentally informs a cast member that she will be fired so that his character will get her character's brain, and Ross plans a surprise for Monica and Chandler's wedding - he wants to play the bagpipes.
Monica and Chandler fondly reminisce about London until a startling revelation leaves Chandler floored. Meanwhile, Rachel teaches Ben practical jokes to play on Ross.
Everybody seems to know who the father of Rachel's baby is except the man himself. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Joey lie about a gas leak to get into Monica and Chandler's apartment.
Ross gets upset when Rachel goes out on a date with a handsome actor, Phoebe tries to prevent a chef from being sacked, and Chandler kills a co-worker's promotion.
At Monica's Halloween party, Phoebe meets the friendly fiancé of her flighty twin Ursula, but becomes alarmed when she learns that her sister has misrepresented herself to her trusting future in-law.

Ross learns that a pregnant Rachel wants to move out and find a place of her own, so he suggests a vacancy in his building. Then he learns that the elderly occupant is not quite dead yet. Meanwhile, Phoebe is ecstatic when Eric dumps her twin sister Ursula and chooses her instead, and Monica comes unhinged when she suspects that her new maid is stealing her jeans, among other things.

Feeling guilty for denying Chandler a bachelor party, Monica hires a stripper to perform for him, without learning that she's a prostitute. Elsewhere, Rachel's father learns about her pregnancy and plans to give Ross a piece of his mind.

A chauvinistic advertising executive acquires the ability to hear what women are thinking. He attempts to use this power to bring about the fall of his female boss. As he uses his knowledge to outwit his superior, he begins to fall in love with her.

Weaving in and out of the love lives of eight loosely inter-related couples. The bachelor Prime Minister falls for his personal assistant, his brother-in-law is flirting with one of his colleagues, a writer heads off to France and pursues an affair with a maid, and an 11-year-old boy asks his father for advice on matters of the heart.

Mr Evans performs to another gigantic crowd on his 2011 tour, where he fumes about breaking down on the motorway, airport hassle, and a certain late-night TV channel he'd recently noticed.

A look at some strange arrests from across the country, a woman urinates in the street during a traffic stop; a pant-less man is arrested for allegedly robbing a doughnut shop; two women drive to a bank with a deceased man in the car; and more!

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a naked woman attempts to elude police by jumping into the ocean; a man attacks a police car with a chainsaw; a woman claims her dad is Jesus Christ; and more!
Multiple petitions filed by Scott Peterson's defence team have introduced additional points of new evidence that may challenge key aspects of the case.
After eight members of one family were killed in their homes in a single night, residents of the devastated Ohio community were left wondering if they might be next.
On an autumn morning in 1999, a teenager vanishes from her home. Seventeen days later, her body is discovered seven miles away. It takes more than 15 years for the heartbreaking truth to emerge.
Examining the murder of Kendal Fenwick, a 24-year-old single father in Baltimore, Maryland.
Step into fear as Pittsburgh detectives hunt a brutal killer whose late night attacks leave the city gripped by terror.

In 2015, Dominic Isom killed his fiancé Samantha Henderson at their Dorset home before calling to report her missing. Her family, unaware of his true nature, supported him while searching desperately for any trace of Samantha.
The sinister story of a woman with money problems who decides her husband is worth more dead than alive.
The story of a man dubbed 'The Grindr Killer', who used dating apps to lure his innocent victims into horrific deaths.
In July 1991, Michael Sams kidnapped Julie Dart and took her to his workshop in Newark where he kept her in a makeshift coffin before killing her after she tried to escape.
Katherine Kelly examines how the murder of 18-year-old Louise Smith rocked the city of Bristol after she disappeared on Christmas Eve in 1995.
Katherine Kelly examines Middlesbrough murderer Reginald Wilson, described by criminal psychologists as one of the most dangerous men ever to be assessed.
Durham couple George and Christina Button lived a happy life, but Christina was secretly mounting up debts. Was murder the only way to pay them off?
When a young mother vanished in Hertfordshire, police suspected she'd run off with a lover. When they eventually found her body, they had only one suspect in mind.
Arguably Britain's most infamous serial killer, Peter Sutcliffe became known as The Yorkshire Ripper when he began murdering women in Yorkshire during the 1970s.
A chilling look at the crimes of Stephen Port, the East London serial killer who poisoned four young men with lethal doses of a date rape drug.

Nineteen-year-old Sade Robinson goes on a first date in Milwaukee and does not return. Within 48 hours, her car is found burned in an industrial area. In the following days, human remains are recovered at multiple sites.

Leslie Reeves, 45, meets Chris Smith for a first date in Farmersville, Illinois. They go to a local bar, then return to his home to continue the evening. In the early hours, an intruder forces entry and opens fire. Reeves is shot in the head and killed.

Sabina Nessa, 28, leaves her home in Kidbrooke, south-east London, running late to meet a man for a first date at a nearby bar. She takes a shortcut through Cator Park. She does not arrive. Her body is found the next day near the path.

In North Carolina, a shady real estate scam leaves Tamera fighting squatters who've seized her beautiful 58-acre property, with her beloved horses trapped inside. As the squatters taunt Flash and his team, tensions explode in a desperate fight.

In Washington, three sisters call on Flash after squatters take over their late grandfather's property. The house has been transformed into a hoarder's den, the backyard into a full-blown junkyard, and squatters seem to appear at every turn.

A husband stumbles from a car and dies in the street after an altercation with his wife spirals out of control. The wife claims she has no memory of wounding him but, when the police investigate, she is charged with Second Degree Murder.

Thirteen days after Pam Pitts disappears in 1988 her charred body is found at a popular hangout spot in the Arizona desert; when a second victim is discovered in a mineshaft, detectives suspect the killer may have known them both.

When 34-year-old Freddie Farah is gunned down in his Florida grocery store, police urgently seek his killer; decades later, Farah's son will have a chance encounter with a cold case detective which brings the case back to life and exposes a killer.

The collision of two supermassive black holes is the most violent event that can occur in the universe; experts explore where a black hole's energy originates and what really happens when the two most powerful objects in the cosmos clash.

In a fictional scenario set in 2029, an asteroid hurtling towards Earth at 40,000 mph will reduce New York to ashes; examining the hypothetical, experts weigh in to determine what could happen, and how it might be stopped.

In Montana, the Raneys intervene with a family on winter's doorstep. They must scramble to expand theirshelter and food storage before beingsnowed in for good. But a surprising revelationin the middle of the rescue threatens to upend the Raneys'plan.
As 25-foot breakers pound the fleet, critical systems fail at the worst possible time.
Mike and Ant turn around a 1965 Dodge Coronet 500, a high-horsepower veteran of the drag strip. They try and dial it back to a more useable street cruiser.

Mike has found one of the icons of the British car industry, a Land Rover Series III from 1976. It appears to have come straight from a safari. It's up to Ant to tame this smoky, leaking beast while Mike mounts a roof rack.
Before Mike and Ant can return home to the UK, they have to pack up the workshop and sort through the work of half a decade.
Mike finds his favourite iconic British car - the Mini Mark 1, in a garage in Wales. Elvis and Mike add some radical changes to the 55-year-old vehicle in order to get it back on the road.
Mike and Elvis take a gamble on a TVR Griffith. However before they can get started the guys have to pick it apart before restoring and testing the full impact of this iconic sports car.

A family of eight sets out to build an underground home in the rolling foothills of Idaho, but Mother Nature has other plans for them; before they even pour concrete, they face a decision that will make or break their build.

After experiencing a devastating tornado, a family wants to build an off-grid retreat overlooking Tennessee's Ocoee River; as amateur builders, they must rely on the help of friends and family, and each other, to reach the finish line.

A couple looks to bring the shores of Key West to their donkey sanctuary in Missouri. Despite having experience with building off-grid properties, they face new challenges as they attempt to construct a double container home deep in the woods.

Oregon homesteaders find their dream in jeopardy following a near-fatal accident; the Raneys face a daunting rescue where a dilapidated bridge has cut them off from their land, and strict building regulations force them to get creative.

An early 20s couple struggle to keep their homestead afloat in torrential Texas weather. But the Raneys face a tense and daunting rescue to save the rain-devastated cabin and soggy livestock shelters under threat of storms and tornado warnings.
The Raneys are in Maine to help a couple whose homestead is overrun with boglands; they build structures to help with the brutal winters.

The crew restores two cabins and builds a barn door for their blacksmith shop; Mark Bowe scouts an old log cabin and drives through a river to visit the fishing cabin he and his crew built two years ago.
A rare, powerful weather system races 1,000 miles across the Great Lakes, unleashing damaging tornadoes in Canada's capital city, Ottawa.
The shop is finally ready to take the Outlaw Porsche to its conclusion.

Will makes miracles happen, and Dave decides to make a wholesale change to the car's colour, but challenges mount at each stage of the build. The upholstery shop changes up their routine as the client arrives for a reveal years in the making.

Josh Gates hunts for the truth behind the world's most iconic and fascinating legends. Leaving no stone unturned, Josh's adventures take him around the globe and into dangerous situations as he dives in to uncover the truth behind enduring mysteries.
Egypt's greatest monuments conceal many unsolved mysteries. Experts investigate tantalising new evidence uncovered from the Valley of the Kings.
Bruce is tasked with creating a display based on the French Resistance: a parachute basket filled with items the RAF would have dropped to the Resistance in WWII.
Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.
Bruce finds a picture in his attic from Dunkirk, given to him by a soldier who was there. Bruce and Hus go on a hunt for kit that tells the real story of the evacuation.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are in Oxfordshire to rummage through a collection of vintage tractors and automobiles. They find a Suzuki SB200 and paraffin dispenser.
In Devon, presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are on a mission to buy automobilia for a client's man cave. The guys uncover a 1937 petrol pump and a pricey tyre inflator.

This time, the duo fondly recall Rodney's rusty lair packed full of signs, petrol pumps and vintage British cars. Rodney found it hard to part with some of the items the deal-searching duo wanted, but they eventually came away with even more.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove rescue interesting items from a scrapyard in Devon. The guys find some classic vehicles, including a neglected Jaguar Mark 1.

Alex and Kevin are on a mission to help Ben and Laura build a cabin on their newly bought claim; the guys hope to negotiate for mining rights, but at 11,500 feet in altitude, the claim is nearly inaccessible -- the only way up is by helicopter.

Alex and Kevin strike a risky deal with claim owners Jerry and Martha. The pair offer to renovate the couple's rundown 30-year-old cabin, but if the land isn't profitable, they will have to negotiate a deal that will make their investment worth it.
Alex and Kevin renovate a mine's machine shop, so the mine can begin generating income. The guys negotiate a deal that could be their biggest payoff yet.
A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.
A French museum asks Bruce for help in acquiring an incredibly rare German Panzer 1 tank. He also explores the remains of secret underground Nazi war factories.
Bruce helps a Texan millionaire who wants to collect memorabilia from the Battle of Normandy. He visits farmhouses and museums to find rare items like a 1942 Luger.

It's the homeward leg and the good old Metisse Steve McQueen Desert Racer has nearly made it. The crew's legendary fixer Predrag Blagojevic takes Henry around his home town of Nis before a quick trip into Sofia, Bulgaria.
Travel, Nature, Action sports, Adventure, Documentary

The US Highway 1 ride is 650 miles long and steeped in American history and iconography, but many tourists only scratch the surface of this sublime journey. There is adventure and luxury to experience in equal measures and the only way to feel the true sense of freedom and escapism is to ride it not drive it. If there is one route that delivers riding the American dream in one easy week, it is US Highway 1.

The 1500-mile journey of extremes takes in the Joshua Tree National Park, Death Valley, Las Vegas, Route 66 and the glorious mountain ride through Sedona to journey's end just south of Phoenix, Arizona. This once in a lifetime ride into this barren yet unendingly beautiful landscape will etch itself permanently on your soul.

The downfall of the powerful Maya city of Palenque continues to mystify archaeologists today. Now, investigators gain rare access to explore lost tombs to reveal the truth behind this legendary city and the mystery behind its enigmatic queens.

A colossal stone temple on a remote Egyptian island mysteriously bears the names of the most famous leaders of the ancient world; now, experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate why pharaohs and emperors all built monuments at this enigmatic site.

The ancient city of Abydos contains some of the oldest Egyptian tombs and a buried temple linked to a mysterious death cult; now, archaeologists use cutting-edge drone imaging to investigate long-hidden secrets behind the first pharaohs.
Metalworker Ted is challenged to repurpose a rusty railway signal light into something better. Alex gets to work restoring a headless carousel animal, while Craig fixes up a lounge chair.
Metalworker Ted gets to work revamping a 19th century Parisian streetlight. Plus, taxidermist Chris uses his skills to restore a tope shark before putting it in a beautiful display case.
Paint restorer Gill improvises with an old vinyl to rescue a 120-year-old Chinese writing table. Sparks are ready to fly as sculpture Nick prepares to work on an iconic garden chair.
New evidence reveals that an American pilot may have returned from Vietnam with a cryptid known as a rock ape.
Expedition X explores an abandoned and haunted outpost in the Amazon rainforest; meeting with tribes deep in the jungle, they hear strange things at night that cause panic.

Phil and Jessica head to Lake Lanier, a manmade lake that covers over 20 cemeteries and the bodies still buried there; they investigate in and around the deadliest lake in America to uncover rumours of drownings and ghostly encounters.
How do they keep the world's tallest twin towers clean? How do they make a jigsaw where every piece is unique? And, how do they craft Olympic level hockey sticks?
Looking at how they fit all the features of a luxury flat into a motorhome. And, how they make a ballet shoe that can take the weight of a dancer on tiptoes.
Looking at how they grow nearly 200,000 tonnes of mushrooms a year in the mushroom capital of the world. And, how they make billions of life-saving gloves.
Looking at how they mine a million tonnes of fertiliser from below the sea. And, how they hand-print millions of colourful clothes using the ancient art of batik.
Experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate what caused the Nazi aircraft to explode into a giant ball of fire over New Jersey in 1937.
Investigating the mysterious disappearances and anomalies within the Bermuda Triangle, such as a USAF training flight that vanished near Florida.
Find out how vibrating mining screens, whoopie pies, wood utility poles, and roller conveyors are made.
Find out how exercise bikes, Cornish pasties, pasta makers, and slate products are made.
Find out how channel signs are created, wetsuits are manufactured, and aluminium aircraft are made.
How custom shoe trees, clay targets, squeeze chutes, and composite boat propellers are made.
Remote-controlled diving robots are mostly used when things get hot in the water, for example when servicing oil drilling platforms. An expert explains how such a modern high-tech diving robot works.
Ever wondered how a Morgan Aero Coupe was made? Join the How It's Made crew as they go to its birthplace, explore the inner workings and its gorgeous exterior.
Ever wondered how a Porsche 911 is made? Join the How It's Made crew as they go to its birthplace, explore the inner workings and its gorgeous exterior.
Ever wondered how a Ferrari FF was made? Join the How It's Made crew as they go to its birthplace, explore the inner workings and its gorgeous exterior.
Justin climbs on top of a stadium roof that is held up by air and in danger of collapse. Meanwhile, Jimena Gascon discovers why Mexico City's Metro project has been derailed.
Justin travels to Turkey to uncover the truth behind a landslide that wiped out a ski jump resort, before jetting off to Gibraltar to see one of the craziest airports in the world.
Dark matter and energy battle for the cosmos and the winner will determine the universe's fate. New discoveries may reveal which force will win.
For 20 years NASA's Cassini spacecraft revealed Saturn's strange secrets until it vaporised in its atmosphere. Now, fresh data points to new discoveries.
More everyday items go under the microscope. Find out how common objects including Montreal smoked meats and motorised scooters are made.
More everyday items go under the microscope. Find out how common objects including cactus pear purée and lab reactors are made.
A look at the production processes behind everyday items. How are common objects including digital paintings and badminton rackets made?
More everyday items go under the microscope, revealing their production processes. How are objects including dumplings and brass taps made?
Using state-of-the-art science, Jeremy Wade chases new leads in pursuit of the Loch Ness monster's hiding place.
Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid and looks at whether this underwater monster is the legendary kraken.
Houdini's mysterious sudden death may not have been an accident. Experts recreate his buried alive escape and investigate if he was killed by more sinister forces.
Special access to cutting-edge factories reveals how America's favourite foods are made and how assembly lines produce huge amounts of hot dogs, chocolate bars and other treats.
Supermassive black holes are so large they devour stars and shape galaxies. The latest science may answer why they grow so large.
Recently disclosed audio recordings and astonishing photographs may provide the most conclusive evidence to date that the Ozark Howler may have demonic origins.
A panel of motoring experts discuss the five greatest sports cars ever made. These cars are the speedy game-changers whose iconic designs have endured the test of time.
A passion project by a few mechanics ended up creating a new kind of car, the hot hatch. A panel of motoring experts discuss the five best hot hatches of all time.
A panel of motoring experts discuss the five finest luxury cars ever made. These are the sumptuous vehicles for those who want to travel in comfort as well as style.
In Idaho, Farmtruck and AZN host eight local drivers to compete for $5,000 and a chance to race NOLA's Kye Kelley. But after a heated negotiation, Kye's not sure he's got this win in the bag.
In Colorado, Farmtruck and AZN host eight small-tire drivers to battle the thin air and each other for $5,000. Then, the winner gets a chance at conquering the No Prep King himself, Ryan Martin.
In Ohio, eight local drivers compete for $5K and the winner gets a chance to race OKC Street Outlaw Jeff Lutz. But Jeff might not have this one in the bag.
Bike guru Henry Cole and ace-mechanic Sam "The Engine Whisperer" Lovegrove remember their visit to Eamon's place in Oxfordshire, where they were searching for vintage treasure to restore.
Ant and his dad find a perfect Woodie, but there's a catch. There's no engine! The farmhouse is in danger of collapse due to rotten wooden beams.
Home improvement, Auto, Reality, Documentary, Entertainment
Master mechanic Ant Anstead restores and sells classic cars to help fund the renovation of the 500-year-old farmhouse he bought for his mum and dad.
Ant revamps a 1972 beach buggy giving it a radical twist, but has he gone too far? And the scale of the farmhouse renovation starts to hit Ant.
Ant finds a rare 1978 TVR Taimar in an Oxfordshire Garden. Despite oil leaks, dodgy paint and a missing heater box, he's hooked.
Duncan talks Ant into buying a 1991 BMW 30 325i, convinced there's profit to be made. Meanwhile, Ant races to finish the hallway of the farmhouse.

Henry and Sam are rummaging about in what can only be described as a tractor enthusiast's heaven. Sheds and fields full of tractors and machinery, some in mint condition and others buried under a mass of weeds, hedges and grass.

Henry and Sam find themselves down in the South West rummaging around another belting shed with all sorts of things on offer. So much so that it is virtually impossible to pick one thing - so they come back with a handful.

The deal-searching duo are at it again, this time in Cornwall. There's plenty more to look at, including some rare early-1900s steam-powered cars. Henry might even be lucky enough to have a go in one.

Henry and Sam are in Somerset with Mark and his amazing motorbikes. Their tongues hang out when they encounter his fabulous Matchlesses, Sunbeams and Martinsydes. Only trouble is, they're all priceless.

Mike goes in search of what many fans consider to be the last truly great Porsche. What he finds is the cheapest, tattiest 993 in the country. Edd lavishes some care and attention on the car, and the duo attempt to make a profit.
Mike and Ant take a chance on a 2006 Porsche Cayenne Turbo S. This performance SUV has a lot of horsepower - but potentially daunting repair bills.
Mike and Elvis take on a Porsche 911 in rough shape: it turns up in pieces on a trailer. If they can revive it, they'll take it on an epic drive through the Cairngorms.

Mike nabs a Porsche 997 at a bargain price of just £15,000, however, a deal this good must have a catch. This car is carrying an engine with a serious case of bore score, which will need all of Elvis's expertise.
Mike is excited to pick up one of his favourite types of convertible: the 2000 Porsche 996. With only a few issues, this car will be an absolute steal for him.
Mike takes on a Porsche 924, the first car he ever turned around on the series. Will fixing oil leaks and worn interior be enough to earn a profit?

A 1950s American pick-up truck offers the Cogs their first chance of car-show glory, if they can restore it to pristine condition. And Richard gets a shot at driving in the biggest classic car race of the season, providing he can impress his mentor.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

Paul Bertram und Sandra Payne verfolgen in Großbritannien einen rücksichtslosen Raser. Er macht keine Anstalten anzuhalten und gefährdet das Leben anderer Verkehrsteilnehmer. Mit einer Nagelkette gelingt es der Polizei, den Wagen zu stoppen.

Callum Donoghue und Steward Wilson haben an diesem Tag schon acht Einsätze hinter sich. Dabei ging ihnen unter anderem ein Fahrer ohne Versicherungsschutz ins Netz und sie haben zwei Messer sichergestellt. Doch die Schicht ist noch nicht vorbei.

Für Dani und Michel Kraemer beginnt ein neuer Lebensabschnitt. Das Trucker-Ehepaar fährt seit Kurzem für ein norwegisches Fuhrunternehmen. Bald geht es zum ersten Mal ans Nordkap, aber vorher soll das Duo in Fauske Fischfutter abliefern.

Auf langen Touren muss Beatrice Donghi oft in der Koje schlafen. Dann verbringt sie die Nacht wieder getrennt von ihrem Freund Michael, der auch Lkw-Fahrer ist. In dieser Folge verabredet sich das Paar an einer Tankstelle in Italien zum Frühstück.

Cristina Molano und ihre Kollegen kontrollieren am Hafen von Barcelona einen verdächtigen Lieferwagen. Der Fahrer behauptet, lediglich Mitbringsel für Familie und Freunde geladen zu haben. Doch dann entdecken die Beamten gefälschte Markenartikel.

Dominikus Pfeiffer bastelt an einer Offshore-Plattform. Florian Landwehr und Thorsten Stock arbeiten währenddessen mit dem 3-D-Drucker. Sie bauen einen Mercedes-Benz L 911 mit Allrad-Antrieb. Rainer Kamitz arbeitet an einer Pitts Spezial S1-S.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Ein geheimes Treffen mit einem kambodschanischen Schatzsucher bringt Josh auf die Spur gestohlener Denkmäler. Josh taucht in einen schlammigen Wassergraben und findet eine unschätzbare Statue und ein Stück eines Nationalschatzes.

Um die Prüfung in der Wildnis zu meistern, muss Trish in Peru noch drei Tage durchhalten. Aber ihre Kräfte schwinden, denn die Naked-Survival-Kandidatin ist sehr unterernährt und kann sich kaum noch auf ihren Beinen halten.

Jeff hat mit Pfeil und Bogen ein Warzenschwein erlegt. Aber die Jagdbeute könnte hungrige Räuber wie beispielsweise Hyänen anlocken. Wenn ein ganzes Rudel ins Lager eindringt, wären Jeff und seine Partnerin Kerra gegen die Tiere chancenlos. Das Duo muss einen zweiten Dornenwall errichten, um das kostbare Fleisch zu schützen. Bei der nächsten Prüfung sollen die Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten eine hängende Falle zum Fang von Vögeln und Kleinwild bauen.

Ed Stafford besucht im brasilianischen Amazonasgebiet die Sateré-Mawé. Das Dorf des indigenen Volkes liegt am Rio Andirá. Dort pflegt die Stammesgemeinschaft alte Bräuche. Dazu gehört auch das Tucandeira-Ritual: Junge Männer tragen dabei Handschuhe, die mit Kugelameisen gefüllt sind. Ihr Stich gilt als extrem schmerzhaft, und die Qualen können viele Stunden andauern. Die große Frage lautet: Wird Ed das Ritual aus sicherer Entfernung beobachten - oder nimmt er selbst an der Zeremonie teil?

Das Team muss sich in einem Nationalpark in der Nähe von Quinninup um einen kaputten alten Traktor kümmern und ihn abschleppen. Außerdem eilt Luke einem Bootsbesitzer zur Seite, der mit seiner zehn Meter langen Jacht stecken geblieben ist.
Das Team soll im Northern Territory im Auftrag des Gemeinderats ein berüchtigtes Wahrzeichen bergen.

In Northern Territory verwandeln sich die trockenen Ebenen bei hohen Niederschlägen zu Schlammwüsten und erschweren dem Team die Arbeit. Dies führt dazu, dass die Crew Baumaschinen mit einem Oshkosh-Panzerbergungsfahrzeug aus dem Dreck ziehen müssen.

Eine Ticketkontrolle am Bahnhof Clapham Junction entwickelt sich zum Großeinsatz: Dutzende Kontrolleure und Polizisten gehen gemeinsam gegen Schwarzfahrer vor. Während ein Fahrgast versucht zu fliehen und von der Polizei gestoppt wird, geraten andere Reisende wegen fehlender Tickets in Schwierigkeiten. In einem Zug sorgt ein Streit zwischen Kontrolleuren und einem Fahrgast für Aufregung, als sich plötzlich andere Passagiere einmischen.

Am Bahnhof Waterloo geraten Ticketkontrolleure an einen Teenager, der über die Schranke gesprungen ist und anschließend medizinische Hilfe braucht. Währenddessen verfolgen Ermittler auf der Elizabeth Line eine hartnäckige Ticketbetrügerin. Mit Überwachungskameras rekonstruieren sie ihre täglichen Wege und versuchen, sie auf frischer Tat zu stellen. Die Frau hat den Verkehrsverbund schon um über 3000 Pfund betrogen.

Der Goldpreis ist auf einem Rekordhoch. Deshalb soll Parker Schnabels Schatzsucher-Team eine vierte Waschanlage in Betrieb nehmen. Doch "Big Red" ist in keinem guten Zustand. Auch Tony Beets will das Eisen schmieden, solange es noch heiß ist.

In Devil's Chute steht das wertvollste Holz. Kate und Matt halten dort bereits Ausschau nach geeigneten Riesen-Lebensbäumen. Aber der Umzug in das Erntegebiet stellt Jared Douglas und sein Team vor große Herausforderungen.
Der Forever Claim verspricht hohe Einnahmen - diese Chance will sich Jared Douglas nicht entgehen lassen.

Diesmal versucht Josh Gates, hinter die Umstände von drei mysteriösen Todesfällen zu gelangen. Er ergründet den Fluch von Tutanchamun. Und er untersucht das Verschwinden eines Mannes bei Area 51 und einen Unfall im Uralgebirge im Jahr 1959.

Als Travis Walton im Herbst 1975 in den Bergen von Arizona spurlos verschwindet, kommen Gerüchte auf, dass der Mann von Aliens entführt worden ist. Neue Indizien bekräftigen die Theorie! Auch der zweite Fall sorgt bis heute für Furore. Es geht um den amerikanischen Luftfahrtpionier Charles Lindbergh, dessen Baby im März 1932 in einem Vorort von New Jersey entführt worden ist. Eine neue Analyse des Autopsieberichts wirft gravierende Fragen über das Familiendrama auf.
Daria was born with a genetic disorder that's left her with a deformed mouth and jaw. Isaiah was born with his organs back to front and no jaw at all.
A lost property auction reveals an old-school boom box from the 1980s, while a buyer is over the rainbow about a rare 'Wizard of Oz' piece in a sealed trunk.
A once-in-a-lifetime auction in South Africa, a ceremonial mask from the Congo, and an item worth $10,000.

When Wayne's all-original 1954 Studebaker Commander Starliner Coupe is invited to compete at the world's most prestigious car show, he's determined to bring home a top prize; Wayne takes a chance on a 1938 Lincoln Model K Coupe with hot rod vibes.

Wayne transforms a 1931 Packard 840 Roadster Packard and encounters a very unexpected buyer; Wayne loans "Wheeler Dealers" host, Mike Brewer, a '57 Ferrari Testa Rossa; a simple parade lap at a state fair turns into a day at the racetrack.
Wayne resurrects a 1962 Jaguar XKE SI 3.8 Flat Floor Roadster that had been hidden for decades. Plus, he and the crew spruce up an OSCA for an exclusive car show.
All the Concept Corvette's elements are built and assembled, but Dave needs to find a buyer. Plus, a Rock 'n' Roll icon brings his '34 Ford coupe to the shop.

Dave Kindig turns out one-of-a-kind vehicles for his demanding (and sometimes famous) clientele. Working on all types and periods of cars we'll see cars rendered, designed, built, and restored from the ground up.
An abandoned '67 C10 that has been sitting for years has been sold to a client. He wants a few new touches, but closer inspection reveals more work is needed.
Dave convinces the client to make the '67 C10 truck into a convertible. Plus, Kevin takes on a new personal project with a Cadillac Escalade.

Actor Brad Pitt recruits Drew and Jonathan to help him surprise his friend and makeup artist of 30 years by renovating her detached garage. They turn her 400-square-foot unit into a guest suite, makeup station and storage area.
Jeremy Renner is moving his mum to LA to be closer to her family. He calls on Drew and Jonathan to transform her dated condo into a cosy oasis for entertaining.
Richard's team work overtime to complete their first big restoration: a 1950s Alvis. Plus, they are under pressure to get their racing MGB fit for competition.
Richard must come up with a plan to raise emergency funds. Plus, the team enter their first race at Donington Park, but engine problems threaten to derail the whole project.

The shop hits the road to check out the competition. Will and Dave's cousin Brad comes along for the ride to share their view on the cars they come across. They team up to challenge Dave in an autocross.
What starts out as a simple engine repair on a 1935 Roadster V8 turns into a full rebuild. The shop gets pushed to the absolute limit on this car.

Forrest Galante arrives in his home town, Zimbabwe, to look for the mysterious Cape lion along with his crew. However, his task is not easy, as there is some cruel wildlife waiting for him in the jungle.

On one of his most audacious and exciting expeditions to date, Forrest travels to the remote Galápagos Islands in search of the fabled Fernandina tortoise. The clues are here, along with an abundance of unique species.
Chad and Eric find signs of gold at the abandoned mine, but nightfall brings an unwanted stalker to their camp. At the Bead Site, the team unearths an ancient structure.

Disaster strikes when Duane and Charlie attempt to drill down a smoke vent at the Bead Site. Chad and Josh follow the fault line back to the collapsed mine. Eric explores an indigenous site in Ohio that holds clues to Blind Frog Ranch.

After receiving brand-new, frightening reports, Josh Gates sends Jessica and Phil to the woods of southern New Jersey to hunt for the infamous Jersey Devil. Locals are terrified by a demonic creature that's terrorised them for more than 300 years.

When Josh Gates receives new, potential video proof of a giant creature living in Lake Champlain, he sends Phil and Jess to investigate the 30-foot serpent that's been spotted in the lake for generations.
Rebecca vomits up to 12 times an hour and is regularly hospitalised. Jacque has a lymphatic malformation in her face that means she has never talked.
Simon is chasing a fit girl in the year below, so to impress her, he goes to his first gig since his mum took him to see Take That at Wembley Arena.

The diners in the First Date restaurant include single mum Frankie and primary teacher Charlie, Olive and Terence who are both in their 80s, and a 34-year-old divorcee Karen with her blind date Mitch.

A long, hot summer in the capital kicks off with a swish garden party, hosted by none other than 'Made in Chelsea' alum Mark-Francis Vandelli. Rumours swirl when American actor Margo Stilley returns to London following a decade in Malibu.

Designer Lottie Kane unashamedly lives and breathes fashion. So why should that be any different now that she's pregnant? British socialite Martha Sitwell tries to turn over a new leaf with a little help from some interior design.

Gordon visits Fleming, a Danish restaurant in Miami, Florida. It was once the best family-run restaurant in town, but now the place is on its last legs. Fleming was bought by husband and wife team Andy and Suzanne eight years ago, in the hope of continuing the restaurant's past success, but with no clue about Danish cuisine it's no real surprise the place is losing money. Can Gordon save their bacon?

Gordon is at Sushi Ko in California. Owner Akira was a successful sushi chef at someone else's restaurant so he and his wife Lisa decided to branch out on their own. When they started, business was booming, but it soon slowed down. They're losing up to $20,000 a month and Akira is a shadow of his former self. Gordon is Sushi Ko's last hope.
Dee Dee's plan to meet her teacher after school goes awry. Leah flees the hospital in search of answers. And when Imran finds Lucas in Chester, things take a dangerous turn.

Manhattan's Black Pearl, a struggling seafood restaurant with three different owners running the kitchen, has come to chef Gordon Ramsay for help; one of the owners is resistant to change and questions every move Gordon makes.

Sammy, the owner of Sabatiello's restaurant in Stamford, Conn., is more than $1 million in debt when he asks for chef Gordon Ramsay's help; when Gordon criticizes the food, Sammy's temper flares out of control.
Gordon helps out at Jack's Waterfront in St Clair Shores, Mich., a lakeside restaurant in a popular summer spot.

Chef Ramsay heads to Cranbury, N.J., to help two friends who bought a French Bistro they used to work in. A disgusting discovery in a kitchen cooler forces Ramsay to shut the restaurant down on the busiest night of the year.
Owner Waleed's hopes and dreams literally go up in flames when a fire breaks out at his restaurant's big relaunch.
Bread Week sees the bakers tackle a garlicky Signature and endure one of the most disastrous Technicals in the show's history.
When Homer is accused of stealing a million-dollar painting, only a detective from the 1970s can clear his name.
Marge, Homer and the kids discover Moe is estranged from his family and mount a grand plan to bring him and them back together.
Lisa rediscovers her love of jazz when the family wind up in New Orleans. Bart discovers Louisiana's voodoo, while Homer discovers its booze.
While on his deathbed, Grampa makes a big confession to Homer, but things get awkward when he then puts in a full recovery.
Homer gets far more than he bargained for when he gets Flanders a job at the plant. Marge frets the spark has gone from her and Homer's marriage.
An insurance payout sends the Simpsons on a trip to Denmark, where they hope to get free healthcare for Grampa.
The final four teams face the ultimate elimination in a magical Harry Potter challenge to secure their spot in the grand finale.

In the epic adventure film 'Independence Day', strange phenomena surface around the globe. The skies ignite. Terror races through the world's major cities. As these extraordinary events unfold, it becomes increasingly clear that a force of incredible magnitude has arrived. Its mission: total annihilation over the Fourth of July weekend. The last hope to stop the destruction is an unlikely group of people united by fate and unimaginable circumstances.

The best moments of Series 7 as Britain's favourite famous faces tune in for the best TV on the box. Featuring, 'Coronation Street', 'Open House: The Great Sex Experiment', 'Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: Australia', 'Match Me Abroad' and more.

Howard Payne is the taunting psychopath threatening LA with high explosives, and Jack Traven the agent who's close to catching him. When Payne loads a bus with bombs, Jack must evacuate the passengers while keeping the vehicle travelling at over 50 mph, with the help of Annie, who's never driven a bus before.

Fitness fan Rose feels her body's getting all the attention and her love life's struggling. Basingstoke barista Clarissa seeks her dream woman and both singletons hope that the naked pods will bring joy.
A misunderstood teenager and a reanimated Victorian corpse embark on a murderous journey together to find love, happiness, and a few missing body parts.

Maud is a reclusive young nurse whose impressionable demeanour causes her to pursue a pious path of Christian devotion after an obscure trauma. Now charged with the hospice care of Amanda, a retired dancer ravaged by cancer, Maud's fervent faith quickly inspires an obsessive conviction that she must save her ward's soul from eternal damnation, whatever the cost.
Richard Shelton returns victorious from the War of the Roses only to discover that his father has been murdered.

Set aboard the USS Corsair, a submarine on active duty. Against his wishes, Ward Stewart is made executive officer and given just days to prepare. Before boarding, he meets schoolteacher Jean Hewlett, and is captivated. He plans romance, unaware that she already has a sweetheart: Dewey Connors, commander of the Corsair and Stewart's boss. A new girl at an LA high school finds it difficult to make friends, and teams up with three fellow outcasts known as the Bitches of Eastwick. However, her telekinetic powers turn the supernatural games in which the three have been dabbling, into something much more sinister.

In the 1930s Chicago, groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious brings a murdered young woman back to life to be a companion for Frankenstein's monster. What happens next is beyond what either of them could ever have imagined.

Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

Still living in quarantine due to the rage virus, a survivor decides to venture into the dark heart of the mainland. He soon discovers a mutation that has spread to not only the infected, but other survivors as well.

When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

Shaun's humdrum existence takes a turn for the interesting when the undead take over London. Leaping into action, Shaun gathers his loved ones in the safest place he knows. Shaun, his mum and her boyfriend, his girlfriend, Liz, and his flatmates Ed and Pete fight off a fate worse than death from the local pub.

Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

At a remote forest cabin, five friends discover a Book of the Dead and unwittingly summon an ancient demon. The malevolent entity possesses each person in succession, until only one is left intact to fight for survival.
After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

Louis Bloom finds himself falling head first in to the shady world of crime journalism. He quickly develops a taste for the profession and discovers that he has got both the business acumen and a strong enough stomach to fend off his rivals.
In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.
Movie, Action, Romance, Comedy, Crime drama, Thriller
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.

Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.
A chronicle of the crimes of Ted Bundy, from the perspective of his longtime girlfriend, who refused to believe the truth about him for years.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.
A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.
The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.
Movie, Family, Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy, Action

Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous 'Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.
A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.
Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.

A trio of reluctant adult siblings join their parents on a Christmas river cruise through Europe, each dealing with personal issues, only to find unexpected joy, romance, and family bonds along the journey.

A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum. As he embraces positive holiday stories, romance blooms - but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.
Valerie teams with a handsome doctor to solve the mystery of who actually owns her family land.

An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honouring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.
With a deadline looming, editor Isabell retreats to her family's cabin for inspiration. A local rancher helps her revive the Christmas Festival and discover the ending to her own story.
With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

The fate of humanity is at stake when two races of robots, the good Autobots and the villainous Decepticons, bring their war to Earth. The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.
As humanity picks up the pieces after an epic battle, a shadowy group emerges to gain control of history. Meanwhile, a powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth.
As war with the Transformers rages on, inventor Cade Yeager forms an unlikely alliance with Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the planet.

A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.
A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural walking talent as they challenge the sport's top competitor.

Chep wants to return a favour to Mush-Mush, but all Mush-Mush wants is to have a compost pancake on Pancake Day. Mush-Mush's favourite frog has its home taken over by a lizard. Mush-Mush and his best friends Chep and Lilit have all kinds of adventures in the forest. They are the protectors of the forest, and they all have a unique power.

Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.

After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.

In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favourite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.

Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.
Movie, Romantic comedy, Music, Rock, Pop

Hot-shot police officer Nicholas Angel smells foul play when the residents of a sleepy Somerset village start to die in seemingly terrible accidents. He must work with a local officer, Danny Butterman, to uncover the truth.

Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished. Trying to help some teenagers, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now David's in big debt to his supplier, and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.
Outrageous antics ensue when Jim, Michelle, Stifler and the gang get back together for their 13-year high school reunion.
After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

The most famous actress in the world. A second hand bookshop owner in Notting Hill. After colliding in the street they begin a relationship which is soon fraught with complications as the tabloid press hound her. He must then summon all his charm, ingenuity and patience if there is to be a happy ending.

A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

West Virginia family man Jimmy Logan teams up with his one-armed brother Clyde and sister Mellie to steal money from the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina.
